role: Assigned research engineer and analysis author; research tooling remains project lead

scope.additional_read_only_inputs: Full-precision learned JSONs beside the supplied summary.txt files, saved replacement checkpoints, frozen CinC NPZ and local model/loader code were necessary to recover exact/per-organ results; no fitting or selection was repeated.

precision.calculation: Unrounded source floating-point values retained in JSON; no rounding before means, SDs or intervals.
precision.display: All continuous report metrics use six decimals. Counts, epochs and identifiers remain integers.
precision.sd_definition: sample SD across four seeds, ddof=1
precision.pooled_definition: sqrt(sum squared errors across observed target cells / number of those cells), across the full 12-hour forecast; average these per-seed RMSEs across seeds.
precision.paired_definition: replacement minus learned per recorded seed; negative favors replacement, positive favors learned.
precision.ci_scope: Two-sided 95% Student t intervals on four paired seed differences; unadjusted for multiple comparisons; no patient-level uncertainty.

published.interpretation: Published mean ± reported spread; the single current seed cannot reproduce an aggregate variability estimate.

ours.command: python3 -B grafiti_p12_reproduce.py --run --archives data/cinc2012/set-a.zip data/cinc2012/set-b.zip data/cinc2012/set-c.tar.gz --seed 0 --device cuda --threads 4 --epochs 200 --batch-size 128 --out artifacts/p12_seed0.json
ours.original_published_target_field: to be read from the paper by the project lead

gap.formula: gap=ours test MSE-published mean MSE; relative gap=gap/published mean MSE

reproduction.verdict: Differs by +0.016702 MSE (+5.839788%): our 0.302702 exceeds the published 0.286000 ± 0.001000. This single-seed adapter attempt does not match the published reported band and cannot reproduce its multi-run variability.
candidate_reasons_from_protocol_only: Paper/code split and fold discrepancies: deterministic released-code split and one fold versus the paper CV/holdout statement.
Paper Adam versus released-code AdamW optimizer choice.
Released-reader hourly aggregation defects retained for compatibility.
Inherited adapter architectural qualifications, including scalar-width completion, rather than an asserted upstream-identical model.
One fixed seed and different model initialization order; no hyperparameter/seed search.
Published per-example risk expression versus executable pooled observed-cell loss.
reproduction.causal_attribution: These are documented candidate explanations/qualifications, not experimentally isolated causes of the gap.

all_protocol_setting_decisions.source_evidence_verbatim: P §6.4: first 36 h; R `-ct 36`; Q `t <= observation_time`

all_protocol_setting_decisions.source_evidence_verbatim: P Table 2 next 3 steps; R `-ft 0`; Q default 3
all_protocol_setting_decisions.executable_choice_verbatim: Next three **stored hourly rows** with `t > 36`. They may skip empty clock hours; actual per-patient target times enter the model. Missing/padded target slots carry no query edges.
all_protocol_setting_decisions.reading_note: Targets are the next stored hourly rows, which can skip empty clock hours.

comparability_qualifications: Historical learned fits used CPU; replacement fits used CUDA. Pairing is by seed ID and within-model protocol, without a contemporaneous learned CUDA control.
Learned metrics use the historical masked_metrics float32 reduction; replacement host metrics use float64 accumulation. The pooled comparison retains the original source values.

Missing replacement per-organ metrics were recovered from saved best checkpoints by CPU inference with float64 accumulation; these are labelled as recovered, rather than falsely attributed to absent run-JSON fields.
GraFITi is a receiver-conditioned incidence ablation changing shared-time representation; it has no native learned channel adjacency to swap.
t-PatchGNN fixed arms bypass/freeze graph-learning modules; GraFITi retains learned temporal attention and inherited final-node-gradient qualification.
Four-seed sample intervals cannot establish equivalence; all comparisons retain existing architecture, losses and training budget rather than constituting a hyperparameter search.
ablation.interpretation: On CinC-2019, learned cross-variable weighting has no clear pooled advantage for GraFITi under this declared incidence ablation: physiological minus learned RMSE is +0.000085 on A-test and +0.000134 on external B; every GraFITi replacement interval includes zero. For t-PatchGNN, all replacement graphs raise A-test RMSE: physiological +0.002542, random +0.004538, complete +0.004620, with each A-test interval above zero. External B changes are smaller: physiological +0.000571 (interval includes zero), random +0.001438 and complete +0.001229 (unadjusted intervals above zero). The physiological prior therefore retains more of the t-PatchGNN A-test performance than the other fixed alternatives by their recorded means, but it does not improve either model over its learned baseline by mean pooled RMSE. Inside t-PatchGNN it supplies fixed row-normalized receiver/source propagation weights in place of the adaptive adjacency at every block, while graph-learning embeddings, gates and dynamic projections are bypassed/frozen and the remaining network trains. Inside GraFITi it supplies fixed cross-variable messages to a separate time state for each receiving variable, retaining learned temporal attention; this changes the shared-time representation and is not a swap of a native variable-adjacency tensor. These are associations within the recorded comparison: learned controls were fit on CPU and replacements on CUDA, with differing metric accumulation; the seed-paired intervals do not isolate a device-free causal graph effect or establish equivalence.
